meta.note: Tyler’s General Fund for the year that began Oct 1, 2026. The departments and transfers below come from the city’s General Fund statement and add up to $104,501,466 exactly.
facts: The city tax rate is $0.242063 per $100, up from $0.236452. The city says a median-valued home ($240,428) owes about $582 a year.
Sales tax is the General Fund’s biggest revenue: $45,175,855, versus $33,827,912 from property tax.
The city states it owes $0 in debt secured by property taxes. Its debt is paid from water and sewer bills, hotel taxes, and airport fees.
Council adopted it Sept 9, 2026: four for, one against, one present and not voting.
